description: Free. Put your own video or audio file into AwesomeVideo and get a fileId for caption_video, transcribe, burn_captions, create_clips, remove_silences or preview. action start: one single-use PUT URL (valid 15 min, files up to 80 MB); start_multipart: parts[] of PUT URLs for files over 80 MB (up to 2048 MB / 3 h) or flaky connections; status: missingParts of a multipart upload; complete: finish a multipart upload after every part is PUT; abort: cancel an unfinished multipart upload (deletes its parts); inline: send a clip of up to 10 MB as base64 in one call. For a public link use import_url instead. Up to 30 uploads per hour.

action.description: start (single PUT URL), start_multipart, status, complete, abort, or inline (base64 up to 10 MB).

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

data.description: File bytes as base64 (a data: URL prefix is accepted).

anyOf.description: fileId returned by upload {action:'start_multipart'}, after every part has been PUT.
fileId of an unfinished upload from upload {action:'start_multipart'}. Completed uploads are not affected.
File name to store, with extension (e.g. talk.mp4); used for the content type and download name. Max 200 characters.
Exact file size in bytes (the PUT must match).

sizeBytes.description: Exact file size in bytes (the PUT must match).

name: upload

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.
